messages:
Tessa: Quick panel prep for Tue 3pm candidate (IC: backend). Can folks confirm availability and who will scribe? Also finalizing scoring weights — proposal below, please ack.

Marco: I can make 3pm, happy to scribe if needed. Quick question on weights: is "system design" separate from problem-solving?

Priya: Thanks — yes, separate. For this role we want focused weighting: Problem-solving 60%, System design 20%, Collaboration/communication 20%. If you didn't observe a section, normalize the others to 100% (e.g., if you only scored problem-solving and communication, scale them so the totals sum to 100%).

Samir: @Priya noted. I can scribe if Marco wants to stay on the tech deep-dive.

Marco: Thanks @Samir. One quick ask — can we use the short scoring template so debriefs are consistent? Example I paste below: 

```csv
candidate,problem_sol,system_design,communication,overall_notes
jsmith,4/5,3/5,4/5,"solved with hints; good api thinking"
```

Elena: I'll cover the behavioral anchors during the interview and add a short note on signal strength.

Interview Bot: Calendar invite updated: Tue 3pm (Zoom). Panel list and Zoom link attached.

Tessa: Awesome — summary: panel confirmed (Marco on tech, Elena behavior, Samir scribe), weights 60/20/20, use CSV/short template for scores, normalize if needed. I'll pin the debrief form to the event and add a 20m buffer after the interview for scoring. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks everyone — see you Tuesday.
